title: [I/O Starvation] Complete system freeze/Watchdog timeout during heavy
body: Hello everyone, I've been fighting a severe I/O starvation issue for a while now, and I have exhausted almost all standard troubleshooting steps. I am experiencing complete system lockups during large file transfers, and I suspect it might be deeply tied to dm-crypt/LUKS. The Symptoms: Whenever I transfer large folders (e.g., 100GB+ game folders containing large .rpf files) between my SSDs, the entire system slowly grinds to a halt. KDE Plasma (Wayland) freezes completely. Eventually, systemd-journald and systemd-logind get a Watchdog timeout (limit 3min) because they are completely starved of I/O, and systemd kills them via SIGKILL/SIGABRT, crashing my entire session. My Environment: OS: Arch Linux (installed via archinstall, multiple fresh installs) DE: KDE Plasma on Wayland Hardware: Multiple NVMe SSDs (Happens between Internal <-> Internal, and External <-> Internal) Encryption: ALL drives are encrypted with LUKS. What I have tried (None of these solved the issue): Different Kernels: I have tested linux, linux-lts, and linux-zen. The 122-second hung task and watchdog timeout happen on ALL of them. Different Filesystems: I formatted the drives and tested BTRFS (with and without quotas, with and without CoW enabled), EXT4, and XFS. The issue persists across all filesystems. Sysctl Tweaks: I tried lowering vm.dirty_ratio / vm.dirty_background_ratio and even switched to strictly low vm.dirty_bytes / vm.dirty_background_bytes to prevent buffer bloat. Did not help. I/O Schedulers: Switched NVMe scheduler from none to bfq. Did not prevent the freeze. KDE Specifics: Completely disabled Baloo file indexer to prevent background reading. Issue still happens with Dolphin/KIO. Journal log: btrfs_commit_transaction+0x7d2/0xd40 btrfs_sync_file+0x45a/0x5b0 Dolphin dosyayı kopyalarken her dosya sonrası fsync çağırıyor. BTRFS fsync sırasında transaction commit etmeye çalışıyor. Aynı anda harici disk (dm-1, EXT4, LUKS şifreli) bağlantısı kesildi: Buffer I/O error on dev dm-1, logical block 60850176, lost sync page write JBD2: I/O error when updating journal superblock for dm-1-8. Aborting journal on device dm-1-8. BTRFS transaction harici diskteki EXT4 journal'ı bekliyor, o da ölmüş durumda. İki thread 122 saniye boyunca state:D (uninterruptible sleep) kaldı, sistem dondu. Kök sebep: Harici diskin dosya sistemi EXT4 + LUKS. Bağlantı kopunca journal abort oluyor ve BTRFS bunu bekliyor. Çözümler: Kısa vadeli — Dolphin yerine rsync kullan, fsync davranışı farklı: rsync -av --no-whole-file /run/media/berkkucukk/Backup/"Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced"/ ~/Documents/"Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced"/ Kalıcı çözüm — harici diski BTRFS'e formatla, EXT4+LUKS yerine. İkisi aynı filesystem olunca bu tür journal çakışmaları olmuyor. Ya da harici diskteki LUKS şifrelemeyi kaldır, sadece EXT4 bırak.  berkkucukk@msi ~/ journalctl -b | grep -E "freeze|hung|blocked|stall|oom|kill" | tail -30 [1:06:23] Apr 02 01:04:08 msi systemd[1]: Listening on Load/Save RF Kill Switch Status /dev/rfkill Watch.
